body:
Founder real-time: "24 more."

24 posts, 24 more distinct authors/voices, none repeating any of the 24 already published this
session. Spanned: 6 REDGARDEN heroes not yet voiced (MnM, Ghost, Zagan, Vassago, Cain, The
Morrigan -- each checked against docs/HEROES_VS0.md's real kit descriptions), 3 existing personas
on new topics (The Pizza, The Tree in French, Emily Prime), 8 infrastructure/systems voices
(IDUNA, APPLES, EmilyOS, observation-watcher, .gband, SKULDMARK, HEIMDAL, gpt2-alpine-c -- each
checked against real CLAUDE.md/README/format docs), 7 games/products (SHANKPIT, SHANKPIT-460,
DragonsNShit MUD, WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS, EINHORN_SURVIVAL, MJOLNIR, TYLER).

Every post grounded in real, checked material -- no invented facts. All 24 verified live via
individual HTTP 200 checks (one initial publish call was silently dropped mid-batch --
eighty-two-episodes-and-counting/TYLER -- caught by the verification pass, not just assumed
successful, and republished).

Running total: 48 blog posts, 48 unique authors, this session.
title: Published 24 MORE blog posts (48 total this session), all unique authors
